en: O Śrī Buddha, Lord of Buddhas, embodiment of the Buddha, endowed with the Buddhas—you, the Awakened One, awaken them all;
having satisfied all the sons of the Buddha through your wisdom, you indeed [pervade] the clouds of Buddhas by means of yoga. (1)

O Śrīvajra, O Vajrāmala, O you who are born from the vajra, having illuminated the world with your blazing vajra, you bestow a rain of vajras through yoga; O Suvajra, you fashion a vajra-natured body.

O Śrīratna, O Ratnākara, O Ratnamegha, you delight in jewels with your jewel-like splendor; with the great banner of jewels and your sublime luster, you shatter the dense cloud of poverty for all people. (3)
O Śrīpadma, Padmottama, Padmasattva, you awaken all the lotuses with nets of lotuses and with lotus waters; O Supadma, born from a lotus, you establish them within the Lotus family.
O Śrī Viśva, enter into the universe; you are universal knowledge, anointed by the universe which has the universe as its object.
Through the universe, discipline all beings; grant me universal wisdom, that excellent knowledge matured in happiness. Thus, [5]
The Praise to the Five Blessed Tathāgatas is completed.
